node_notes.Display: The display service initializes the startup splash and renders sensor readings and event text. firmware/services/display.c uses the SH1106 driver and sends transfers through platform_io_transmit.
node_notes.DhtDriver: This driver validates a DHT22 frame checksum and converts raw values to temperature and humidity. firmware/drivers/dht22/dht22.c provides dht22_decode, called by the sensor service.
node_notes.App: This module coordinates sensing, ride-event handling, display updates, and telemetry from app_start. Its calls to the named services and platform I/O are visible in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.Dht: This is the DHT22 data connection used for pulse-based frame capture. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c reads and drives APP_DHT_PIN on APP_DHT_GPIO_PORT, configured as PB4.
node_notes.MpuDriver: This driver configures the MPU6050 and converts acceleration register bytes into g values. firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu6050.c obtains register access through the platform I/O callbacks.
node_notes.Sensors: The sensor service schedules MPU6050 and DHT22 reads, calibrates acceleration, and exposes a snapshot to the application. firmware/services/sensors.c calls the platform I/O functions and the MPU6050 and DHT22 drivers.
node_notes.Console: This sink represents the console/log output carried by USART2. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c sends application log strings and telemetry bytes through the UART peripheral.
node_notes.Uart: USART2 carries diagnostic logs and queued telemetry bytes using the configured PA2 TX and PA3 RX pins. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c initializes USART2 and uses HAL_UART_Transmit and LL_USART_TransmitData8.
node_notes.ShDriver: This driver generates SH1106 initialization commands and transfers display pages. firmware/drivers/sh1106/sh1106.c is used by the display service with address 0x3C.
node_notes.Platform: This STM32 module owns the application's GPIO, I2C1, TIM3, and USART2 I/O. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c configures the relevant pins and implements the HAL/LL transfer functions.
node_notes.Ride: This module detects and expires ride events from acceleration samples and derives the alert LED state. firmware/modules/ride_events.c implements sample-window comparisons and ride_events_update.
node_notes.Telemetry: This service formats snapshots and ride events as VPD1 CSV records and submits them for UART transmission. firmware/services/telemetry.c calls platform_io_telemetry and uses APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS.
node_notes.Oled: The SH1106 receives initialization commands and display page data at address 0x3C. firmware/services/display.c defines DISPLAY_ADDRESS and the SH1106 driver performs its transfers.
node_notes.Bus: I2C1 connects the MPU6050 and SH1106 using SCL PB8 and SDA PB9. firmware/configs/app_config.h defines those pins, and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c initializes I2C1 and issues transfers.
node_notes.Led: This is the board indicator driven according to the logical LED state. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c calls HAL_GPIO_WritePin using APP_LED_GPIO_PORT and APP_LED_GPIO_PIN, configured as PA5.
node_notes.Mpu: The MPU6050 provides acceleration samples and is addressed at 0x68. firmware/configs/app_config.h defines APP_MPU_ADDRESS, and firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu6050.c reads its identity and acceleration registers.

node_notes.Start: app_start begins the telemetry hook and initializes local ride-event and LED state. firmware/app/app.c then attempts platform I/O initialization before entering its loop.
node_notes.SendTelemetry: The service emits a VPD1 CSV record only when its configured telemetry interval has elapsed and queues it through platform I/O. firmware/services/telemetry.c implements telemetry_process and APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS.
node_notes.RefreshDisplay: When display initialization succeeded, the application advances display splash or dashboard work using the current readings. firmware/app/app.c calls display_process, implemented in firmware/services/display.c.
node_notes.Stop: A failed platform I/O initialization makes app_start return rather than run without its required I/O. This early return is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.UpdateRide: The ride-event module selects the active event and computes the alert LED state. firmware/modules/ride_events.c implements ride_events_update, called by the app loop.
node_notes.DisplayActive: Ride-event sampling and updating occur only when the display initialized successfully and its splash state has ended. This condition is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.ClearRideSample: When acceleration is invalid, the application passes NULL to ride_events_sample to clear the sample history. This branch is implemented in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.DriveLed: The application writes the computed LED state and logs only changes from the previous state. firmware/app/app.c calls platform_io_led, whose board output is PA5.
node_notes.ReadSnapshot: The application retrieves the current sensor snapshot after processing sensor work. firmware/app/app.c calls sensors_snapshot for the latest readings.
node_notes.InitServices: After board I/O is ready, the application initializes the display and sensors and sets up ride-event state. These calls are grouped in firmware/app/app.c before the forever loop.
node_notes.SampleRide: The application constructs a ride_sample_t from the valid acceleration values and timestamp. firmware/app/app.c passes it to ride_events_sample.
node_notes.IoInit: platform_io_init configures the LED and UART pins, USART2, I2C1 on PB8/PB9, TIM3, and the PB4 DHT line. The initialization implementation is in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.
node_notes.IoReady: This branch controls whether app_start continues or returns when platform_io_init fails. The condition is implemented in firmware/app/app.c immediately after the initialization call.
node_notes.ReportChanges: When the selected event changes, the application updates display event text and emits event log messages. firmware/app/app.c compares the event with previous_event and performs those actions.
node_notes.Loop: Each cooperative iteration polls telemetry and platform I/O and obtains the current tick. firmware/app/app.c performs these operations at the start of its main loop.
node_notes.AccelValid: A valid acceleration sample is submitted to ride-event history; an invalid one clears that history. The validity branch is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.ProcessSensors: The sensor service performs timed MPU6050 and DHT22 acquisition, calibration, and snapshot validity updates. firmware/services/sensors.c uses APP_MPU_PERIOD_MS and APP_DHT_PERIOD_MS for its scheduled reads.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as STM32 startup
  participant App as app_start
  participant IO as platform_io
  participant Display as display service
  participant Sensors as sensors service
  participant Bus as I2C1 devices
  participant Ride as ride_events
  participant UART as USART2 console

  Boot->>App: Call app_start
  App->>IO: platform_io_init
  IO->>UART: Initialize USART2 on PA2 and PA3
  IO->>Bus: Initialize I2C1 on PB8 and PB9
  IO->>IO: Initialize TIM3 and DHT22 data pin PB4
  alt platform_io_init fails
    App-->>Boot: Return without starting main loop
  else platform I/O ready
    App->>Display: display_init
    Display->>Bus: Initialize SH1106 at address 0x3C
    App->>Sensors: sensors_init
    Sensors->>Bus: Initialize MPU6050 at address 0x68
    loop Cooperative app_start loop
      App->>IO: firmgen_telemetry_poll and platform_io_poll
      App->>Sensors: sensors_process with current time
      Sensors->>Bus: Read MPU6050 registers when sample interval is due
      Sensors->>IO: Read DHT22 frame when climate interval is due
      App->>Sensors: sensors_snapshot
      alt Display ready and splash complete
        alt Acceleration sample valid
          App->>Ride: Submit acceleration sample
        else Acceleration sample invalid
          App->>Ride: Clear sample history
        end
        App->>Ride: Update events and LED request
        App->>Display: Set event text when event changes
      else Display not ready or splash active
        Note over App,Ride: Ride-event processing is skipped
      end
      App->>IO: Set LED state on PA5
      App->>Display: display_process when display initialized
      Display->>Bus: Transfer SH1106 page data as needed
      App->>IO: platform_io_log for changed event or LED state
      IO->>UART: Transmit log bytes
      App->>IO: Queue telemetry record when its interval is due
